name: OCR PDF
description: Make a scanned PDF searchable by recognising its text.
seoTitle: OCR a scanned PDF — make it searchable free | PDFChill
seoDescription: Add a searchable text layer to a scanned PDF with in-browser OCR. Free, no uploads — nothing leaves your device.
disclosure: Recognition runs entirely in your browser, so nothing is uploaded. That also makes it slower and a little less accurate than a cloud service — and the language model is downloaded once on first use.
